schema:
CREATE TABLE demo_files (
                    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    path      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                    filename  TEXT NOT NULL,
                    file_size INTEGER,
                    map_name TEXT,
                    total_rounds INTEGER,
                    team_a_score INTEGER,
                    team_b_score INTEGER,
                    team_a_name TEXT,
                    team_b_name TEXT,
                    duration_mins REAL,
                    match_date TEXT,
                    match_date_source TEXT,
                    status    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
                    added_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
                    parsed_at TEXT,
                    error_msg TEXT,
                    display_name TEXT,
                    source TEXT,
                    watch_root TEXT,
                    remark TEXT
                , content_md5 TEXT, origin_zip TEXT)

CREATE TABLE match_results (
                    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    demo_path    TEXT NOT NULL,
                    result_json  TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE demo_result_summaries (
                    demo_path TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
                    clip_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    primary_target TEXT,
                    analyzed_targets_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                    four_k_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    five_k_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    result_created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    summary_version INTEGER NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE demo_player_stats (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    demo_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    demo_path TEXT NOT NULL,
                    steam_id64 TEXT,
                    steam_id TEXT,
                    account_id TEXT,
                    user_id TEXT,
                    player_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    normalized_name TEXT,
                    team_name TEXT,
                    team_number INTEGER,
                    kills INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                    deaths INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                    assists INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                    kd REAL DEFAULT 0,
                    indexed_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )
CREATE INDEX idx_demo_files_status_id ON demo_files(status, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_demo_files_path_nocase ON demo_files(path COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX idx_demo_files_filename_nocase ON demo_files(filename COLLATE NOCASE)
